mainEntity.name: What does partition wall framing usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on wall length, height, door openings, materials, and whether the wall needs electrical, insulation, or drywall finishing. A straightforward partition wall is usually far less expensive than modifying a load-bearing wall, but hidden conditions can raise the price quickly.
